item.title: Girls Book Maker ~Grimm to Sannin no Ohime-sama 3~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yumemiru
  • 発売日: 2020-07-31
  • スコア: 7.290000000000001/10 (43 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ガールズ・ブック・メイカー ～グリムと三人のお姫さま 3～
  • 英語名: Girls Book Maker Grimm to Sannin no Ohime-sama 3

あらすじ

“Dancing is not something you do alone.”

Acting prince Eito goes to an ash-covered mansion in the prince-less world of Grimms’ Fairy Tales. As soon as he enters the mansion, he finds the character “Cinderella” hard at work cleaning up.

At first glance, everything looks fine, but she’s so busy cleaning the mansion, doing housework, and practicing her dance moves that she makes him anxious. Eito decides to support Cinderella as the “acting prince”.

  • 日本語名: ガールズ・ブック・メイカー グリムと三人のお姫さま 2
  • 英語名: Girls Book Maker Grimm to Sannin no Ohime-sama 2

あらすじ

“I want to be a newlywed!”

Eito, who continues to act as the acting prince, asks for help for the character “Ibara”, who is said to wake up only when called by the “prince”. Naturally Eito, who is not a real prince, is unable to wake her up, but the next day he finds Ibara napping in the city street.

item.title: Girls Book Maker ~Grimm to Sannin no Ohime-sama 1~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yumemiru
  • 発売日: 2020-02-28
  • スコア: 7.5/10 (48 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ガールズ・ブック・メイカー ～グリムと三人のお姫さま 1～
  • 英語名: Girls Book Maker Grimm to Sannin no Ohime-sama 1

あらすじ

“——The prince has disappeared!”

Or so told the Register of Grimms’ Fairy Tales to the Head Librarian of the Great Library.

In order to deal with the situation, the Librarian sends the protagonist Kuri Eito and Tale to the troubled stories’ worlds.

Eito and his friends search for the prince, along with the eccentric Register Grimm, whose personality changes frequently, and Shirayuki, an optimistic girl who is easily get carried away, yet they can’t find him at all.

item.title: Girls Book Maker -Shiawase no Libretto-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yumemiru
  • 発売日: 2019-05-31
  • スコア: 7.779999999999999/10 (134 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ガールズ・ブック・メイカー -幸せのリブレット-
  • 英語名: Girls Book Maker -Shiawase no Libretto-

别名

  • GBM

あらすじ

The protagonist, Eito, suddenly finds himself gazing at the grand edifice of an otherworldly Library. Just moments before, he should have been in the confines of the academy’s tiny library.

The girl who introduces herself as the “Head Librarian” tells him this Library is a repository of every story known to existence. If the books in the Library are damaged, the stories they contain will be lost to the real world.
